Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NPCIL General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NPCIL GDMO recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the NPCIL General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) posts is scheduled for 04 September 2026. Candidates must ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the GDMO post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is MBBS with a relevant PG Diploma including DRM or equivalent from a recognized university. Alternatively, an MBBS degree with one year of post-qualification relevant experience is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the GDMO position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the GDMO post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the GDMO role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 127,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this NPCIL GDMO recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the NPCIL GDMO recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) posts will be based on a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Palghar, Maharashtra, with the pincode 401504. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) positions are contractual in nature, as indicated in the job details provided.
